name: Warehouse: triggers before backfill, one-way sync, dual-write
read: SELECT id, fulfillment_bin AS value FROM stock_items ORDER BY id
write: UPDATE stock_items SET pick_bin = :value, fulfillment_bin = :value WHERE id = :id
insert: INSERT INTO stock_items (id, pick_bin, fulfillment_bin) VALUES (:id, :value, :value)
